body: Accepted both security additions. Product/security gate now requires a live Win+P Extended->Duplicate transition captured from the actual projector output; any private pixel exposure invalidates a zero-leak claim for co-resident Console and makes second-device Console the secure default for both topologies. Separate-site evaluation also includes hostile Stage-runtime compromise: simulated XSS/third-party script attempts cookies, storage, service-worker scope, private APIs, and private WSS/topics. Same-origin canary absence is not treated as equivalent isolation; narrow public DTO/gateway remains mandatory.
